1 Subject Tender is floated on Limited Tender (LT) basis and Vendors eligible to p articipate have been short-listed and approved by Competent Authority as per ‘ Works & Procurement Policy of NTPC’. Email will be sent to the aforesaid shortlis ted vendors for participation in the subject tender on GeM Portal. Only those bidd ers who have received the aforesaid invitation mail from NTPC should participate in the subject tender. In case any vendor in receipt of the said mail has multiple v endor codes in NTPC linked to that mail ID, it would be responsibility of the vendo r to obtain a confirmation, by using the representation window in GeM, regarding the vendor who is eligible to bid against the tender. Any bid received from non- eligible vendor linked to that mail ID will be rejected. Any Other Bidder(s) who is not shortlisted/approved by Competent Authority for t his Bid and have not received email in this regard, shall not be considered and bi ds of such bidder(s) shall be summarily rejected during Technical Evaluation. Authorized Dealers/ Channel Partners of those "manufacturers" who have receive d the aforesaid invitation mail from NTPC can also participate in this tender. How ever, such dealers/ channel partners shall have to submit a Bid-Specific Authoriz ation Certificate from the manufacturer along with their bids. GeM Contract shall be issued in the name of the vendor who submits offer in GeM. Authorisation issu ed by any bidder who is not a manufacturer will not be considered valid. However, if a shortlisted manufacturer authorises multiple dealers/ channel partn ers to submit bids, all such bids shall be rejected on the ground of conflict of Inte rest detailed later in the document.

2 Nil deviation clause for all schedules: Compliance to ALL provisions of the bidding document (Nil Deviation bid) is mand atory which is to be accepted through the “Seller undertaking” during submission of offer by the seller in GeM. Through their acceptance, the seller undertakes the following: “1. With reference to our bid submitted against the tender, we hereby confirm th at we comply with all terms, conditions and specifications of the Bidding Docume nts read in conjunction with Amendment(s) / Clarification(s) / Addenda/Errata (if a ny) issued by the Employer prior to opening of Techno-Commercial Bids and the s ame has been taken into consideration while making our Techno-Commercial Bid & Price Bid and we declare that we have not taken any deviation in this regard. 2. We understand that in case the Products and/or Services offered do not meet t he technical requirements, then our bid shall be rejected as Technically non-resp onsive. We also confirm that in case we refuse to withdraw additional conditions/deviatio n s/variations/exception, implicit or explicit, found anywhere in the techno-comm ercial bid, our bid shall be rejected as Technically non-responsive. We further confirm that if any deviation/variation in any form is found in our Price Bid, the EMD shall be forfeited”. 3 If any seller/bidder has any clarification against technical specification or otherwi se on any aspect of this bid, they can raise their representation against the same by using the Representation Window provided in the bid details field in Seller das hboard after logging in as a seller within the time period after bid publication as a llowed by GeM. Clarification asked through any means other than above, may no t be considered by NTPC.

4 Bidder may quote as per "Technical Specification" and/ or spec sheet attached for each line item/ schedule. In case of any contradiction between Category/ BOQ Ite m description and "Technical Specification" of the item(s) attached in the tender, TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION OF THAT ITEM SHOULD BE CONSIDERED FOR THE SU BMISSION OF OFFER AND SAME SHALL BE CONSIDERED FOR EVALUATION PURPO SE AT OUR END. The details mentioned in the detailed Technical specification sha ll be considered final for the offer/ bid/ technical evaluation. Bidder has to quote make and model in GeM as per option available in GeM durin g submission of offer after meeting all the technical specification of tender. After opening of bids, any change in vendor's quoted make or model in their bid canno t be done and any such request will be rejected. In the event of an order, vendor ’s quoted make and model in their bid will also get automatically populated in th e GEM Purchase order. Also, MSE & MII benefits will be given exclusively based o n documents submitted in reference to the "quoted make and model" submitted in the GeM bid. 5 Guarantee/Warranty: 12 months from the date of use/commissioning or 18 mont hs from the date of supply, whichever is earlier. (The Guarantee/ Warranty Terms and Conditions shall be applicable to the material supplied against the PO. No se parate Guarantee/ Warranty Certificate is required to be submitted by the Suppli er along with the material. The Guarantee / Warranty terms and condition shall b e binding on the supplier). If any higher Guarantee/warranty mentioned in the tec hnical specification the same shall be applicable. 6 Common IP Addresses: - Bidders may please note that GeM is capturing and pres enting to the buyer the IP addresses used by the Buyer and the Bidder(s) /Seller(s). The received bids having matching/common IP address with eithe r Bidder(s)/Seller(s) or Buyer, shall be outrightly rejected & shall not be consi dered for further evaluation. 7 During techno-commercial evaluation of offer, clarification/ reply to the queries (if asked by NTPC) given by bidder will be considered an integral part of the GeM pu rchase order and the vendor will be liable to execute the PO also in accordance w ith the same. Furthermore, in the event subsequent clarification(s)/query(ies) are sought and bidder fails to respond or responds with incorrect / inadequate or non -compliant information, the bid will be liable to be rejected. Subsequent represen tation(s) may not be accepted in such cases. 8 The Bidder shall be held solely responsible for non-submission of bids on the e-te nder portal due to any reasons within the due date/ time, The Procuring Entity/NT PC shall not be held responsible or liable in any manner for the same. Bidders shall follow the guidelines/instructions available on the e-tender portal an d are advised to submit their bids well before the due date and time to avoid any inconvenience or risk of non-submission. All post award communication/ grievance will be addressed to consignee at email id: storeincharge-ramagundam@ntpc.co.in. In case of non-resolution of the issue, matter can be escalated along with previous correspondence(s) to email id :- vendor_grievance_cpg2@ntpc.co.in.

9 Payment terms: The payment shall be released after successful delivery and acc eptance at site. 10 Make in India (MII): Provisions of Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India), Order 2017 and it s subsequent amendments/ revisions issued by DPIIT is not applicable in this ten der. Hence, all suppliers (Class-I/ Class-II/ Non-Local Sup pliers) can participate in this tender. 11 CONFLICT OF INTEREST: A bidder shall not have conflict of interest with other bidders. Such conflict of inte rest can lead to anti- competitive practices to the detriment of Employer’s interes ts. A bidder may be considered to have a conflict of interest with one or more par ties in this bidding process, if: a) they directly or indirectly control, or are controlled by or are under common co ntrol of another entity; or b) they have the same legal representative/agent for purposes of their bids; or c) they have relationship with each other, directly or through common third part y(ies), that puts them in a position to have access to information about or influen ce on the bid of another Bidder; or d) Bidder and/or any of its allied entity(ies), which directly or indirectly control(s) or is(are) controlled by or is(are) under common control of another entity, has(ve ) participated as a consultant in the preparation of the design or technical specifi cations of the contract that is the subject of the tender; or e) Bidder participates in more than one bid in this bidding process. f) In cases of agents quoting on behalf of their principal manufacturers/service pr oviders, one agent cannot represent two manufacturers/service providers or quot e on their behalf in a particular tender enquiry. One manufacturer/service provid er can also authorize only one agent. There can be only one bid from the followin g: i) The principal manufacturer/service provider directly or through one Indian age nt on his behalf; and ii) Indian/foreign agent on behalf of only one principal. For the purposes of this clause the term ‘control’ shall have the following meanin g: “Control” shall include the right to appoint majority of the directors or to control t he management or policy decisions exercisable by a person or persons acting ind ividually or in concert, directly or indirectly, including by virtue of their sharehold ing or management rights or shareholders’ agreements or voting agreements or i n any other manner. Vendor has to submit CONFLICT OF INTEREST declaration in bid during submissio n offer as detail as “We confirm that we have read and understood the Buyer Add ed Bid Specific ATC Clause regarding “Conflict of Interest” and our bid is in compl iance to this clause. In case it is established that we have provided any false info rmation in pursuance of the aforesaid Clause, while competing for this contract, t hen our bid shall be rejected and bid security shall be forfeited. We also understa nd that in case we become successful bidder, if it is established that we have not

complied with terms of aforesaid Clause, during execution of contract, this would be considered as fraudulent practice as mentioned in para 5.1 (j) of “Policy for De barment from Business Dealings” and shall be dealt accordingly.” Note: Policy for Debarment from Business Dealings available at "https://ntpc.co.i n/sites/default/files/policy- documents/Policy_for_Debarment_from_Business_Deal ings.pdf". ( Compliance to “Conflict of Interest” provisions) We confirm that we have read and understood the ITB* Clause regarding “Conflic t of Interest” and our bid is in compliance to this clause. In case it is established that we have provided any false information in pursuanc e of the aforesaid ITB* Clause, while competing for this contract, then our bid sha ll be rejected and bid security shall be forfeited. We also understand that in case we become successful bidder, if it is established that we have not complied with terms of aforesaid ITB Clause, during execution o f contract, this would be considered as fraudulent practice as mentioned in para 5.1 (j) of “Policy for Debarment from Business Dealings” and shall be dealt accor dingly. 12 Risk purchase- In the event of Suppliers failure to supply the material of acceptab le quality in scheduled delivery period, NTPC reserves the right to procure the ma terials from any other source at the Suppliers risk and cost and the difference in c ost shall be borne by the Supplier. Further, NTPC shall retain the right of forfeitur e of CPG/ PBG and or any other action as deemed fit. 13 Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI): Not Applicable 14 EMD BG: NOT APPLICABLE 15 Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) Detail: NOT APPLICABLE

16 MSME benefit (purchase preference) is to be given as per following conditions: In case of procurement of goods/ services, preferences to MSEs whose quoted pri ces are within L1 (non-MSEs) +15% range (subject to matching of L1 price) will b e given in the following order: a) SC-ST Women MSEs b) SC-ST other than Women MSEs c) Women MSEs d) Other MSEs The MSE order quantity will be as per following: i. Where the requirement is Not-Splitable: 100% of contract quantity will be awar ded to MSEs. ii. Where the requirement is Splitable: 25% of contract quantity will be awarded t o MSEs. In case of more than one MSEs (for the same category) are within range of L1+15 % price, then 25% of tendered quantity will be divided equally amongst them. .
